menu.description: The button that opens the actions of the active saved view.

edited.description: The accessible name of the mark on the active view's tab while it has changes that are not saved.

save.description: The action that saves the changes to the active view, and the button that confirms a save.

saveAs.description: The action that saves the current arrangement as a new view.

rename.description: The action that renames the active view.

revert.description: The action that puts the active view back to how it was last saved.

remove.description: The action that deletes the active view.

cancel.description: The button that closes a dialog of the views and changes nothing.

name.description: The label of the field a view's name is typed in.

selectTitle.description: The title of the dialog shown on switching away from a view that has changes not yet saved.

selectDescription.defaultMessage: This view has changes that are not saved.
selectDescription.description: The body of the dialog shown on switching away from a view that has changes not yet saved.

selectProceed.description: The button that switches to the other view and loses the changes.

revertTitle.description: The title of the dialog that confirms putting the view back to how it was last saved.

revertDescription.defaultMessage: The view goes back to how it was last saved.
revertDescription.description: The body of the dialog that confirms discarding the changes to a view.

revertProceed.description: The button that discards the changes to the view.

removeTitle.description: The title of the dialog that confirms deleting a view.

removeDescription.defaultMessage: The view is deleted for good.
removeDescription.description: The body of the dialog that confirms deleting a view.

removeProceed.description: The button that deletes the view.

saveAsTitle.description: The title of the dialog that names a new view.

renameTitle.description: The title of the dialog that renames a view.

nameDescription.description: The body of the dialog a view's name is typed in.
